evals.prompt: Run setup and add sqlite and postgres for csharp and rust
evals.expected_output: npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli setup --yes --languages csharp rust --datasources sqlite postgres

assertions.text: Runs npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli setup --yes --languages csharp rust --datasources sqlite postgres

evals.prompt: Generate a user with field id: username, is_enabled in types.yaml and generate repositories for csharp
evals.expected_output: types.yaml with user tagged datasource_type; npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli generate all --dialect csharp; then ds.Users create, ReadSingle, Update, and Delete. No hand-written repository class.

assertions.text: Runs npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli generate all --dialect csharp
Writes types.yaml with a user datasource_type and id, username, is_enabled
Calls create, readSingle, update, and delete on the generated users repository
Does not define a hand-written repository class

evals.prompt: The same user table, plus role and a user_role junction tagged many_to_many, with a roles list on user. Generate TypeScript and create a user that has a role.
evals.expected_output: types.yaml with user, role, and user_role; generate all --dialect typescript; ds.roles.create then ds.users.create with roles: [admin]. ReadSingle fills roles. No hand-written AddLinked.

assertions.text: Runs npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli generate all --dialect typescript
Writes user, role, and user_role with many_to_many and a roles list that references user_role.user_id
Creates a role, then a user whose roles list includes that role
Does not call AddLinked or addLinked by hand

evals.prompt: Insert an item and read it back with a command and SQL text. Do not use a repository.
evals.expected_output: CreateCommand, Execute(Native.N INSERT INTO items) with Parameters, ExecuteReader(Native.N SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE id = $id), MetaDataRowTypeConverter Convert. Includes Item. No repository.

assertions.text: Creates a command from a connection
Executes Native.N INSERT INTO items with bound parameters
ExecuteReader Native.N selects id and name from items by id
Converts the reader row with MetaDataRowTypeConverter and includes the Item type
Does not construct a repository

evals.prompt: Read users with a command, convert each row, then build a contacts list from contact_name1 and contact_name2.
evals.expected_output: ExecuteReader of those columns, MetaDataRowTypeConverter User, TransformMapper that fills contacts and reverses it. Read is mapper.Map(converter.Convert(row)). Includes User and User.Contact. Converter does not build the list.

assertions.text: Reads users with ExecuteReader and the contact_name columns
Maps after convert: mapper.Map(converter.Convert(row))
Uses TransformMapper to fill contacts from contact_name1 and contact_name2 and reverse them
Defines User and a nested Contact type
The converter does not build the contacts list

evals.prompt: Write a SelectStatement for Contact.FirstName and ContactType.Name, inner-joining Contact to ContactType on Contact.ContactTypeId = ContactType.Id.
evals.expected_output: SelectStatement Table Contact, Fields Contact.FirstName AS FirstName and ContactType.Name AS ContactTypeName, Join.Inner ContactType on Contact.ContactTypeId and ContactType.Id. No table or column names.

assertions.text: SelectStatement table is Contact
Fields are Contact.FirstName and ContactType.Name with PascalCase aliases
Inner join ContactType on Contact.ContactTypeId and ContactType.Id
Does not put table or column names in the statement

evals.prompt: The type stays user, but the stored table is OldUsersTbl. username is unique and stored as LoginNm, id as UsrID, and is_enabled as ActvFlg. Add datasource.yaml mappings and generate.
evals.expected_output: types.yaml unchanged; datasource.yaml mapping OldUsersTbl, UsrID, LoginNm with is_unique, ActvFlg; generate all --dialect typescript; CRUD still uses username.

assertions.text: Keeps types.yaml as user with id, username, and is_enabled
datasource.yaml maps user to OldUsersTbl
Maps id to UsrID, username to LoginNm, is_enabled to ActvFlg
Sets is_unique on username
Runs npx @deterministic-code/datasources-cli generate all --dialect typescript
Create, read, update, and delete still use Username / username
